maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from temperature-controlled and dry van truckload freight transportation, not repair or servicing of customer-owned assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private shippers, such as food and consumer goods companies, paying for refrigerated and dry freight hauling.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically by adding trucks, terminals and lanes; it recently sold intermodal assets to Hub Group.

mission_critical.reason: Truckload freight is largely interchangeable; shippers can move loads to other carriers by price and capacity, despite some dedicated services.
